(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define red-objs (filter (lambda (obj) (= (obj-color obj) 2)) (objects g 0)))
    (define (same-pos? a b)
      (and (= (fst a) (fst b)) (= (snd a) (snd b))))
    (define (has-cell? p cells)
      (any? (lambda (q) (same-pos? p q)) cells))
    (define (same-cells? a b)
      (and (= (length a) (length b))
           (all? (lambda (p) (has-cell? p b)) a)))
    (define (rotations cells)
      (let* ((r0 (normalize-cells cells))
             (r1 (normalize-cells (rotate-cells-cw r0)))
             (r2 (normalize-cells (rotate-cells-cw r1)))
             (r3 (normalize-cells (rotate-cells-cw r2))))
        (list r0 r1 r2 r3)))
    (define (same-rot-shape? a b)
      (let ((sa (normalize-cells (obj-cells a)))
            (rots (rotations (obj-cells b))))
        (any? (lambda (rb) (same-cells? sa rb)) rots)))
    (define (same-count obj)
      (count-where (lambda (other) (same-rot-shape? obj other)) red-objs))
    (define targets (filter (lambda (obj) (= (remainder (same-count obj) 2) 1)) red-objs))
    (define (inside-target-bbox? r c)
      (any?
        (lambda (obj)
          (and (>= r (obj-r1 obj)) (<= r (obj-r2 obj))
               (>= c (obj-c1 obj)) (<= c (obj-c2 obj))))
        targets))
    (grid-from-fn h w
      (lambda (r c)
        (if (inside-target-bbox? r c) 7 (cell-at g r c))))))

(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define red-objs (filter (lambda (obj) (= (obj-color obj) 2)) (objects g 0)))
    (define (same-pos? a b)
      (and (= (fst a) (fst b)) (= (snd a) (snd b))))
    (define (has-cell? p cells)
      (any? (lambda (q) (same-pos? p q)) cells))
    (define (same-cells? a b)
      (and (= (length a) (length b))
           (all? (lambda (p) (has-cell? p b)) a)))
    (define (rotations cells)
      (let* ((r0 (normalize-cells cells))
             (r1 (normalize-cells (rotate-cells-cw r0)))
             (r2 (normalize-cells (rotate-cells-cw r1)))
             (r3 (normalize-cells (rotate-cells-cw r2))))
        (list r0 r1 r2 r3)))
    (define (same-rot-shape? a b)
      (let ((sa (normalize-cells (obj-cells a)))
            (rots (rotations (obj-cells b))))
        (any? (lambda (rb) (same-cells? sa rb)) rots)))
    (define (same-count obj)
      (count-where (lambda (other) (same-rot-shape? obj other)) red-objs))
    (define targets (filter (lambda (obj) (= (remainder (same-count obj) 2) 1)) red-objs))
    (define (inside-target-bbox? r c)
      (any? (lambda (obj)
              (and (>= r (obj-r1 obj)) (<= r (obj-r2 obj))
                   (>= c (obj-c1 obj)) (<= c (obj-c2 obj))))
            targets))
    ;; Stage A: exact canonical odd-class bbox fill.
    (define intermediate
      (grid-from-fn h w
        (lambda (r c)
          (if (inside-target-bbox? r c) 7 (cell-at g r c)))))
    (define orange-objs
      (filter (lambda (obj) (= (obj-color obj) 7)) (objects intermediate 0)))
    (define (better? a b)
      (or (> (obj-size a) (obj-size b))
          (and (= (obj-size a) (obj-size b))
               (or (< (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b))
                   (and (= (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b)) (< (obj-c1 a) (obj-c1 b)))))))
    ;; Stage B: select the unique largest orange component created by A.
    (define selected
      (for/fold ([best (first orange-objs)]) ([obj (in-list (rest orange-objs))])
        (if (better? obj best) obj best)))
    (for/fold ([out intermediate]) ([p (in-list (obj-cells selected))])
      (set-cell out (first p) (second p) 4))))
